prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create one portrait 3:4 premium photorealistic catalogue photograph for 128am Cafe, not a collage.
Use both provided local reference photos as the physical product identity source: image 1 MATCHA LATTE in a short broad clear plastic cup with slightly tapered sides, flat clear lid and white seal under the rim, dark green matcha at top grading into pale green and a thin white milk bottom; image 2 STRAWBERRY MATCHA LATTE in a short broad clear plastic cup with clear dome lid, natural green matcha/milk marbling, pale milk below and deep red strawberry bottom layer. Retain both real cup shapes/proportions, lids and fills exactly; brighten and colour-correct appetisingly without changing recipe. Preserve each front mascot sticker faithfully: cute dark-haired girl with pink bow beside a white bunny with exactly two ears, the 128am Cafe lettering, same compact sticker artwork and scale. Products themselves must remain realistic clear plastic photographed with real light, never an illustration or ceramic tumbler.
Scene: bright airy café morning at a window, two drinks on a pale cream oak tabletop in warm natural daylight. Diffused sheer ivory curtain blurred behind them, window light enters from the left, delicate soft rectangular sunlight shadows on the table. MATCHA left slightly forward, STRAWBERRY right slightly back, both upright with complete cup and lid visible and both stickers facing camera. Editorial café lifestyle photo with 85mm lens look, creamy background bokeh but both products sharply readable. Keep all props minimal and table uncluttered; no food, no flowers, no fruit. Full cups large in lower two thirds with bright cream upper wall/curtain space for copy. Natural colour correction to green tea, white milk and red strawberry base; refined warm white light without yellow cast.
Graphics: generous uncluttered upper space. Fredoka-style bold rounded lowercase rose #B8496C type. Put exact heading "matcha latte" directly above the left cup and exact heading "strawberry matcha latte" directly above the right cup with tidy line breaks. Small "128am Cafe" at top centre. Palette cream #FFF8F5, rose #B8496C, subtle blush #FDE5EB and sage #E7F0DC. Typography consistent across a premium café catalogue. No other text, no prices, no claims, no watermark, no added toppings or fruit, no straw, no hands. ONE completed photograph.
